name: stock-watch
description: /stock: watch tickers and get a chime when one reaches the low or high you set. Works any time, in any session.

watchlist.title: Watch list
watchlist.description: Tickers to watch, separated by semicolons: AAPL 180 200; NVDA high 140; BTC-USD low 60000. Two prices are the low and the high. Applied when a session starts and whenever this text changes. /stock add and /stock rm still work for quick changes.

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Default 60, minimum 30. How often prices are fetched while a session is open. A blank value uses the default.

sound.title: Alert sound
sound.description: chime: a rising tone at your high, a falling tone at your low. chime and voice: also says the ticker aloud (macOS). off: the toast only.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: show: tickers under the prompt, like AAPL 342.46 ▲ · NVDA 227.35 ▼. hide: nothing under the prompt; the /stock pane and alerts still work.

statusCount.title: Tickers in status line
statusCount.description: How many tickers to show under the prompt, 1 to 5. Default 3. The rest show as +N.
